narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms associated with tropical cyclone Claudette produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of southeast Virginia.
ev: Right lane on east bound Interstate 64 was closed due to flooding at Mile Marker 297 (Yadkin Road).
lsr: RIGHT LANE ON EAST BOUND INTERSTATE 64 CLOSED DUE TO HEAVY RAINFALL AT MM 297 (YADKIN RD).
